config.momentum.title: Momentum
config.momentum.key_binding.remap_hint: (Edit brakeKey / driftKey in momentum.json to remap)
config.momentum.option.general.drift_pro:
Choose the behaviour triggered by the Handbrake (Drift) key. Vanilla uses Automobility's speed-only drift; Arcade gives a quick, precise sideslip; Responsive gives a deep, steering-driven slide.

Default: %s
config.momentum.option.general.enabled.d: Turn the entire mod on or off. When disabled, Automobility handles movement, HUD and physics.
Enable Momentum's coasting, acceleration, braking and speed-cap changes.
Enable Momentum's steering ramp, centring and understeer changes.
config.momentum.option.general.camera.de: Enable Momentum's camera lock, pitch and brake-zoom features.
config.momentum.option.general.hud.name: HUD
config.momentum.option.general.hud.descr: Enable the Momentum HUD. When disabled, Automobility's built-in speedometer is used.
config.momentum.option.movement.coast_de: Speed lost per tick while coasting without throttle. Higher values stop the car sooner; lower values let it roll farther.
config.momentum.option.movement.accelera: Divides the raw acceleration force. Higher values make acceleration slower and smoother; lower values make it quicker.
config.momentum.option.movement.brake_de: Speed lost per tick while braking. Higher values stop harder; lower values brake more progressively.
config.momentum.option.movement.comforta: Scales the automobile's comfortable speed cap. Higher values raise top speed; lower values reduce it.
config.momentum.option.steering.ramp_rat: How quickly steering reaches full lock while a direction key is held. Higher values react faster; lower values build smoothly.
config.momentum.option.steering.center_r: How quickly steering returns to center after release. Higher values straighten instantly; lower values return gradually.
config.momentum.option.steering.underste: How much turning is reduced at high speed. Higher values add more realistic understeer; lower values keep cornering sharp.
Shapes when understeer begins relative to speed. Higher values affect only very high speeds; lower values engage sooner.
config.momentum.option.camera.lock.name: Lock Camera
config.momentum.option.camera.lock.descr: Make the camera follow the automobile's yaw every tick.
config.momentum.option.camera.lock_pitch: Camera pitch while lock is enabled. Positive values look downward; lower values give a flatter view.
config.momentum.option.camera.steering_t: Camera yaw offset at full steering lock. Higher values lean farther into a turn; lower values keep the view steadier.
How quickly camera tilt follows steering. Higher values respond immediately; lower values feel smoother and heavier.
config.momentum.option.camera.reverse.de: Turn the camera 180° while reversing, then return it forward during normal movement.
config.momentum.option.camera.reverse_fl: How quickly the camera rotates when entering or leaving reverse. Higher values snap faster; lower values sweep gradually.
config.momentum.option.camera.brake_zoom: FOV reduction at peak braking. Higher values create a dramatic zoom; lower values keep it subtle.
How strongly deceleration drives the zoom. Higher values react aggressively; lower values respond gently.
Strength pulling zoom back to normal. Higher values return immediately; lower values let the zoom linger.
Zoom velocity retained each tick, where 0 stops instantly and 1 never stops. Higher values coast back with more inertia.
config.momentum.option.hud.debug_x.name: Debug X
config.momentum.option.hud.debug_x.descr: Debug overlay X position. Use -1 to anchor from the right with the configured fraction.
config.momentum.option.hud.debug_y.name: Debug Y
config.momentum.option.hud.debug_y.descr: Vertical position of the debug overlay.
config.momentum.option.hud.debug_x_fract: Fraction of screen width from the right edge when Debug X is -1.
config.momentum.option.hud.x.name: X
config.momentum.option.hud.x.description: HUD X position. Use -1 to anchor from the right.
config.momentum.option.hud.y.name: Y
config.momentum.option.hud.y.description: HUD Y position. Use -1 to anchor from the bottom.
config.momentum.option.hud.x_fraction.de: Fraction of screen width from the right edge when X is -1.
config.momentum.option.hud.margin_bottom: Pixels from the bottom edge when Y is -1. Higher values move the HUD farther from the edge.
config.momentum.option.hud.compact_dashb: Use the polished instrument cluster with a stable speed panel and aligned cruise pod. Disable it for the legacy layout.
config.momentum.option.hud.total_width.d: Dashboard width. Compact values below 104 are corrected when saved.
Dashboard height. Compact values below 17 are corrected when saved.
config.momentum.option.hud.bar_width.des: Legacy layout only: width of each bar segment.
config.momentum.option.hud.bar_spacing.d: Legacy layout only: gap between bar segments.
config.momentum.option.hud.max_speed.des: Speed at which every bar segment is filled.
config.momentum.option.hud.bar_color.des: ARGB color of filled bar segments.
config.momentum.option.hud.boost_bar_col: ARGB color of segments that show boost contribution.
config.momentum.option.hud.text_color.de: ARGB color of the speed readout.
config.momentum.option.hud.text_offset_x: Legacy layout only: speed-text X offset from the bar's top-left corner.
config.momentum.option.hud.text_offset_y: Legacy layout only: speed-text Y offset from the bar's top-left corner. Negative values place it above the bar.
Maximum sideways slide angle in degrees. Higher values create a dramatic sideslip; lower values keep the drift subtle.
config.momentum.option.drift.arcade_slip: Degrees per tick that the slip angle moves toward its target. Higher values snap instantly; lower values ease in.
config.momentum.option.drift.responsive_: Fraction of remaining distance closed each tick. Higher values reach the target quickly; lower values ease in slowly.
How quickly the drift angle fades after release. Higher values straighten sooner; lower values let the drift linger.
config.momentum.option.drift.slip_decay_: Reference speed for speed-adjusted decay. Higher values preserve drift longer at speed; lower values keep decay more constant.
config.momentum.option.drift.constant_an: Jump immediately to the configured maximum slip angle instead of building up gradually.
config.momentum.option.drift.steer_sensi: Exponent applied to accumulated steering. Higher values require sustained input; lower values build the slip angle more linearly.
config.momentum.option.drift.steer_build: How quickly accumulated steering rises each tick. Higher values reach full angle sooner; lower values build slowly.
config.momentum.option.drift.steer_decay: How quickly accumulated steering falls after release. Higher values fade sooner; lower values hold the slip longer.
config.momentum.option.drift.trigger_ste: Minimum steering input needed to start a drift. Higher values require near-full lock; lower values trigger with slight input.
config.momentum.option.drift.maintain_st: Minimum steering input needed to maintain the drift angle. Higher values require clear input; lower values accept small corrections.
config.momentum.option.drift.min_speed.d: Minimum automobile speed needed to start a drift. Higher values require more speed; lower values allow slower starts.
config.momentum.option.drift.min_hold_ti: Ticks the drift key must be held before a drift can start. Higher values add delay; lower values trigger sooner.
config.momentum.option.drift.auto_trigge: Ticks without steering before drift starts automatically; 0 disables it. Higher values wait longer.
config.momentum.option.drift.brake_enabl: Apply braking while the drift key is held but no drift has started.
config.momentum.option.drift.boost_enabl: Grant a speed burst when a drift ends cleanly. Disable this to turn the boost off entirely.
config.momentum.option.drift.boost.name: Boost
config.momentum.option.drift.boost.descr: Engine speed added instantly after a clean release. Higher values give a larger burst; lower values give a small nudge.
config.momentum.option.drift.boost_durat: Ticks the boost animation plays; 20 ticks equal one second. Higher values keep it visible longer.
config.momentum.option.drift.min_ticks.d: Minimum drift duration needed to earn a boost. Higher values reward only sustained drifts.
config.momentum.option.drift.camera_enab: Swing the camera with the drift angle. Disable this to keep the camera fixed.
config.momentum.option.drift.camera_scal: How strongly camera yaw exaggerates the slip angle. Higher values swing farther; lower values lean subtly.
config.momentum.option.drift.camera_lerp: How quickly the camera moves toward the drift offset. Higher values follow instantly; lower values move smoothly.
How quickly the camera returns to center after drift. Higher values snap back; lower values settle slowly.
